name: UBE Corporation
summary: UBE Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the materials and machinery businesses in Japan, Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Functional Products, High-Performance Urethanes, Pharmaceuticals, Resin and Chemical Products, Machinery, and Others segments. Its Functional Products segment offers polyimides, separation membranes, ceramics, and separators. The High-Performance Urethanes segment provides urethane resin intermediate, elastomers, and coating products.
